decision_rules.ARCHIVE_ONLY: Frozen design/eval/research/incident/WIP evidence or a qualified experiment that was not selected for production.
decision_rules.KEEP_ACTIVE: Requires concrete ongoing role evidence (attached worktree, active process, current continuation contract or explicit owner state). None exists for the 67 tips.
decision_rules.MIGRATE_TO_MAIN: Only when current main lacks a current-valid capability/repair and branch evidence supports current architecture; migration would be semantic reimplementation, never automatic cherry-pick.
decision_rules.SUPERSEDED_SEMANTICALLY: Patch remains unique but later current-main implementation represents the intent or the old mechanism is obsolete under current architecture.

family_notes.cache-context-accounting: Old cache/history experiments split between frozen evidence and semantics later replaced by current atomic-group/anchor/cache-fold architecture.
family_notes.chatgpt-web-middleware-ingress: Middleware/ingress prototypes and canaries are archival; Phase12 retired the middleware runtime while current main keeps independent Web-GPT integration.
family_notes.context-retrieval-evals: All tips are frozen evaluation or replay evidence; findings may inform future experiments but no branch is a production migration unit.
family_notes.execution-efficiency-tooling: First-call schema fix is semantically present in main; Execution Ledger plan is archival after its treatment saw zero adoption.
family_notes.governance-qualification: Frozen A/B, hold, and governance-gate evidence; no active production branch role.
family_notes.learning-memory-methods: M1 runtime fixes have direct/later main successors; curriculum research remains archival.
family_notes.misc-preservation: Mixed backups/evals/WIP and a few runtime fixes; runtime fixes have later main successors, preservation branches remain archival.
family_notes.provider-protocol-continuity: Research/rescue qualification evidence; current main already contains current provider/file continuity mechanics.
family_notes.runtime-config-service-control: Typed config/service-control runtime has advanced on main; only P0 qualification docs remain archival.
family_notes.smc-actionref-execution: Current main retains Browser mechanical safety invariants; ActionRef/execution-binding qualification lines remain frozen experiments because they were never merge/deploy selected.
family_notes.web-webui-product: Nearly all old Web/WebUI runtime tips have clear current-main successor behavior; the remaining backup is historical only.

key_evidence: No tip is attached to a worktree; direct process recheck found no branch-backed active process.
Execution Ledger S2 result explicitly records zero treatment adoption, no benefit evidence, and no production promotion; later Qwen mini-gate was control-only.

ActionRef P4 line was frozen/qualified experimentally but explicitly stopped before merge/deploy; current main retains GroundingRef/version/single-dispatch/target/receipt/WAL safety invariants without ActionRef.
Phase12 formally retired middleware runtime/worktree after Chrome decoupling; current main has independent Web-GPT integration.

Current main directly contains service verify no_manifest_skip/verify_targets, snapshot-ref write preconditions, evidence source resolution/exact-read recovery, and later Web/Browser/cache/session/subagent behavior.
Projection env-isolation target suite passes 23/23 on current main with LFL_TOOL_WORKING_SET_GRACE_GROUPS=3, so that old test fixture is no longer needed.
M1 nonconvergence/memory intents have direct current-main successor commits 24705c077, f1bfa11d1 and 29c92087d.

next_phase_recommendation.objective: Create a private exact-ref archive bundle/manifest for all 67 tips, with SHA256 and isolated restore drill. No ref deletion until a new human checkpoint.
next_phase_recommendation.potential_post_archive_topology: If owner later authorizes retirement after bundle verification, local branches could reduce from 70 to the three protected refs: main, production, and the existing root-untracked archive branch.
next_phase_recommendation.reason: Phase18 found no branch that needs migration or active retention. A verified bundle can turn all 67 tips into recoverable archival assets before any later local-ref retirement decision.
